say:1:1730158201:1.text: Seems like you're trying to confirm what you already suspect.
say:1:1730158201:1.source_cn: 能问出这个问题，看来你也是有所猜想才是。

say:2:1730158202:1.text: Indeed, rumor has it that Dura once granted King Rolan immortality...
say:2:1730158202:1.source_cn: 我也有听说过，据说罗兰大帝曾受过艾雅祝福成了不死之身……
say:2:1730158202:1.male: Indeed, rumor has it that Dura once granted King Rolan immortality...
say:2:1730158202:1.female: Indeed, rumor has it that Dura once granted King Rolan immortality...

say:3:1730158203:1.text: Alive or not, it makes no difference. No one knows where he is.
say:3:1730158203:1.source_cn: 不过即使知道他活着也没什么用，因为没人知道他在哪里。
say:3:1730158203:1.male: Alive or not, it makes no difference. No one knows where he is.
say:3:1730158203:1.female: Alive or not, it makes no difference. No one knows where he is.
